scripts.build: npm run build:monitor && npm --prefix desktop run build
scripts.build:monitor: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run-dotnet.ps1 publish monitor/ComputerMonitor.Service.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -o artifacts/monitor
scripts.test: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run-dotnet.ps1 test monitor.tests/ComputerMonitor.Tests.csproj && npm --prefix desktop test
